Junior Odoo Developer – Bucharest 
 New Peaks helps companies redesign and digitize how they work, using ERP solutions with Odoo at the core. We're looking for a Junior Odoo Developer to join our team in our Bucharest office. You'll learn Odoo development hands-on, working alongside senior developers and functional consultants on real client implementations, from analysis through development to go-live.
 What we offer: 
A structured start: hands-on training in Odoo development and mentoring from senior developers
Insight into the business side: learn how sales, purchasing, inventory, manufacturing and accounting really work from our functional consultants
Varied implementation projects across distribution, manufacturing, retail, services and e-commerce
Company-supported Odoo certifications and training
A small team where your work goes live with real clients, not just internal tickets
A clear growth path toward medior and senior roles
Competitive compensation
 What you'll do: 
Develop and extend Odoo modules (Python, ORM, XML views, QWeb reports) under the guidance of senior developers
Customize forms, reports and workflows based on functional specifications
Help with data imports, migrations and testing
Fix bugs and support existing clients through our helpdesk
Take part in code reviews, learning our Git workflow and deployment on Odoo.sh
Join client sessions now and then to understand the business behind the requirement
 What we're looking for: 
Good Python fundamentals (0–2 years of professional experience, or strong academic/personal projects)
Basic knowledge of SQL, HTML/CSS and JavaScript
Familiarity with Git and some comfort working on Linux
Eagerness to learn the Odoo framework and understand business processes, not just code
Clear communication in Romanian and English
Based in Bucharest and working from our office
 Nice to have: 
Any Odoo experience (courses, personal projects, internship)
Experience with Django, Flask or another web framework
A degree in Computer Science, Economic Informatics or a related field
 Interested ? Apply here on LinkedIn or send your CV to jobs@newpeaks.eu.
 A GitHub profile or a short note on something you've built is a big plus.
